# Third Party in CHIMERA - WEB Static Assets

This directory contains third-party static assets used in the CHIMERA web interface. It is recommended to keep this directory lightweight and only include essential files.

## DOCUMENTED ASSETS

- `web/static/third_party/bootstrap.min.css` — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- `web/static/third_party/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js
- `web/static/third_party/bootstrap.min.css.map` — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css.map
- `web/static/third_party/bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map` — https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.8/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map
